'''Chris Compton''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2000 Parker tournament (23 December)]] on 23 December 2000 with EBO, according to Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1572">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapterd1572/ parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapter], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 24 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-24-parker-co-12-23-00-the-next-chapterd1572/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
